name: EH3D-STENCILCAM
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.1: a library and a command line that turn the pads of a paste layer (read with the Gerber reader of EH3D-CORE-LIBS) into the openings of a solder paste stencil: each is shrunk by a percentage for the material, rounded, reduced by the kerf of the laser, checked against the aspect and area ratios that decide whether the paste leaves the opening, and written as G-code for a laser or HP-GL for a plotter, mirrored for the bottom side if asked. Polygon and macro pads and tracks are not turned into openings; nothing has been cut.
